mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers corporate earnings concerns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in household demand, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO < 95), firms face higher input costs and reduced output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, but the effect is absent in stable supply conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of INDPRO < 95 instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressure that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL rise periods, or Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing slowdown that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production volatility (INDPRO 6-month standard deviation > 5%), supply uncertainty causes negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days, but the effect is absent in stable supply conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO volatility exceeds 5%, or Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.
